name: Codex executable
responsibility: Finds the pinned Codex executable that a host may run: under the checkout's node_modules, or in the platform package of a release
description: A release starts the native Codex binary of its platform package directly. It finds the package as Node.js finds a dependency: in the node_modules of the release's package, else in that of each directory above it, which suits the nested layout of npm and the hoisted layout of bun add -g. Every executable still passes the bounded --version proof against the pinned version. A native binary also gets the two variables that Codex's own bin/codex.js sets: the root of its package and the package manager that installed it.
